about: What each tool of the chat names of what it shows (specs/2026-11-14-desk-journal.md JR1.3): the examples of naming_test.go run every tool listed here, and the test of the composition of the app (app/desktop) holds every tool its chat offers to be listed.

tools.saga.read: the chapter with the paragraphs shown
tools.saga.search: the chapters of the excerpts shown, the records of the materials shown
tools.saga.chapters: the titles of the chapters, or what the helper learned of them by their cards
tools.saga.glossary: what the helper learned of the chapters of the entries, the records of the materials shown
tools.saga.entity: what the helper learned of the chapters of the profile, the record of the materials whole
tools.saga.timeline: what the helper learned of the chapters of the answer
tools.saga.changes: what the helper learned of the chapters of the answer
tools.saga.scan: the excerpts of the chapters with finds; the chunks name their chapters whole to the gateway
tools.saga.attachment: the attachment with the paragraphs shown
tools.saga.memory: the records of «Вы просили помнить» shown
